title: Tenma Tsukasa — A Rush Of Excitement〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: A Sad Farewell at the Curtain Call

rows.Line: Phoenix Wonderland
Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “Hmph... You're a machine. Speak when you are spoken to.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Understood. Please excuse my insolence.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay, this seems like a good place to end for today.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Alright, everyone, nice work today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Nice work!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (That last scene didn't go the way I'd hoped.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'm definitely still having trouble gauging just how much human expression I'm supposed to be using...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Understood. Please excuse my insolence.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hmm... No, that isn't right either...
I'm giving a quick response like I should, but I need to hold back my emotions less.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa☆

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Nice work today.
About the last scene we just did...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Understood. Please excuse my insolence.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No, now I'm emoting a bit too much.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: However, this is the scene where he decides to speak to Sergeant Willis after seeing her at odds with herself. I doubt he's going to be completely devoid of emotions...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup! I agree!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Same. I know it's not easy, but I think you should be a little more expressive.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I had a feeling...
But you're right. Let's try to... Wait, Emu?! Nene?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehe. You finally noticed!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
How long have you two been here?
Also, were you listening to everything I said just now?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hold on. You really didn't think anyone else would hear...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. For a conversation that you thought you were having with yourself, it was very audible.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?! Rui?! Asahi?! You're also here?!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: I know how you feel. I also had trouble getting a good grasp of that part.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You too, Asahi?

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Yes. It's so difficult to gauge how much of which emotions to use...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: Which in turn changes the image of how I envision Bartlett speaking and behaving in the later scenes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You did seem to deliberately act more robotically there towards the end.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: He's being reprogrammed by the military, so it seemed appropriate to show how his humanity is being chipped away.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: However, despite slowly losing his humanity, something seems to linger and persist within Bartlett.

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: That something is what I believe caused Bartlett to say what he does to Sergeant Willis.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Something lingering inside him...
How that scene is portrayed may vary greatly depending on what that actually is...

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: It's just my interpretation, but I hope that helps.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, very!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'll take that into account while thinking more about this scene. And I'll return tomorrow ready to give a better performance!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line: That's great! I'm looking forward to seeing what you come up with!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
I promise to find an answer that I feel is satisfactory!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hey, don't forget to tell me too.
I'm the one who has to do that scene with you.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, I won't! Don't worry!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Strange... I wasn't able to give my best performance today, but I feel fantastic.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This is completely different from what I went through when trying to play Thorpe. Maybe it's because I'm not as lost as I was that time.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (It's as if each of my experiences is guiding me and telling me what to do...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Anyway, I'll be going now!
See you all tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: See you tomorrow, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Asahi
rows.Line:
He really is interesting...
And such a conscientious actor.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, he is.
